observations: Actually reopened2017 image.23 number and school fascia clearly readable. Immediate complete three-bay house to its left is likely22 by continuous address sequence, but its own22 numeral is not confidently legible in this view. Do not label exact-door-number confirmed.

Candidate22 facade has pale stucco, three bays, five visible tiers including short top tier; decorative relief panels around top sash windows, central first-floor pediment/Corinthian order, balustraded balcony and projecting Ionic porch. Unlike23 it has richer top-tier relief. Ground/door bottom partly obscured by cars/railings; roof/rear unobserved.
